name: Innkeeper
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
wakes: Each night except the first, early (before the Demon).
interaction: Innkeeper chooses 2 players. Both are protected from all deaths tonight; the Storyteller makes one of them drunk until dusk.
drunk_or_poisoned: No protection and nobody is made drunk; the Innkeeper is not told.

jinxes.text: If the Leviathan nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.

rulings.text: Protection covers any death at night (Demon, Minion, Outsider, Townsfolk, Traveller) but not the next day's execution.
The chosen player who is drunk uses their ability to no effect while drunk (Assassin example).
The Innkeeper may choose themselves; if they are the one made drunk, the protection fails for both players.
Safe reminders are removed at dawn, Drunk at dusk.
Night order numbers from bra1n/townsquare develop src/roles.json (firstNight/otherNight; 0 mapped to null).
